arxiv-2101-07560.title: A doubly relaxed minimal-norm Gauss–Newton method for underdetermined nonlinear least-squares problems
arxiv-2101-07560.creator: Federica Pes, Giuseppe Rodriguez
arxiv-2101-07560.description: Abstract When a physical system is modeled by a nonlinear function, the unknown parameters can be estimated by fitting experimental observations by a least-squares approach. Newton’s method and its variants are often used to solve problems of this type. In this paper, we are concerned with the computation of the minimal-norm solution of an underdetermined nonlinear least-squares problem.

arxiv-2105-04770.title: Exact Recovery in the General Hypergraph Stochastic Block Model
arxiv-2105-04770.creator: Qiaosheng Zhang, Vincent Y. F. Tan
arxiv-2105-04770.description: Abstract This paper investigates fundamental limits of exact recovery in the general d d -uniform hypergraph stochastic block model ( d d -HSBM), wherein n n nodes are partitioned into k k disjoint communities with relative sizes ( p 1 , … , p k ) (p_{1},\ldots,p_{k}) .

arxiv-2110-10438.title: Are there magnetars in high-mass X-ray binaries? ∗ 0 0 footnotetext: ∗ * Supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China.
arxiv-2110-10438.creator: Kun Xu, Xiang-Dong Li, Zhe Cui, Qiao-Chu Li, Yong Shao, Xilong Liang, Jifeng Liu
arxiv-2110-10438.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Kun Xu, Xiang-Dong Li, Zhe Cui, Qiao-Chu Li, Yong Shao, Xilong Liang, Jifeng Liu. Magnetars form a special population of neutron stars with strong magnetic fields and long spin periods. About 30 magnetars and magnetar candidates known currently are probably isolated. But the possibility that magnetars are in binaries hasn’t been excluded.

arxiv-2205-13632.title: Operation of Cs-Sb-O activated GaAs in a high voltage DC electron gun at high average current
arxiv-2205-13632.creator: Jai Kwan Bae, Matthew Andorf, Adam Bartnik, Alice Galdi, Luca Cultrera, Jared Maxson, Ivan Bazarov
arxiv-2205-13632.description: Abstract Negative Electron Affinity (NEA) activated GaAs photocathodes are the most popular option for generating a high current ( > > 1 mA) spin-polarized electron beam. Despite its popularity, a short operational lifetime is the main drawback of this material.

arxiv-2209-01077.title: Adapting Kubernetes controllers to the edge: on-demand control planes using Wasm and WASI PubID: pubid: Pre-print of article accepted to IEEE CloudNet 2022] ©2022 IEEE
arxiv-2209-01077.creator: Merlijn Sebrechts, Tim Ramlot, Sander Borny, Tom Goethals, Bruno Volckaert, Filip De Turck
arxiv-2209-01077.description: Abstract Kubernetes’ high resource requirements hamper its adoption in constrained environments such as the edge and fog. Its extensible control plane is a significant contributor to this, consisting of long-lived processes called "controllers" that constantly listen for state changes and use resources even when they are not needed.

arxiv-2307-14771.title: Emerging topological bound states in Haldane model zigzag nanoribbons
arxiv-2307-14771.creator: Simone Traverso, Maura Sassetti, Niccolò Traverso Ziani
arxiv-2307-14771.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Simone Traverso, Maura Sassetti, Niccolò Traverso Ziani. Zigzag nanoribbons hosting the Haldane Chern insulator model are considered. In this context, a reentrant topological phase, characterized by the emergence of quasi zero dimensional in-gap states, is discussed. The bound states, which reside in the gap opened by the hybridization of the counter-propagating edge modes of the Haldane phase, are localized at the ends of the strip and are found to be robust against on-site disorder.

arxiv-2409-08689.title: Real-time observation of frustrated ultrafast recovery from ionisation in nanostructured SiO 2 using laser driven accelerators.
arxiv-2409-08689.creator: J. P. Kennedy, M. Coughlan, C. R. J. Fitzpatrick, H. M. Huddleston, J. Smyth, N. Breslin, H. Donnelly, C. Arthur, B. Villagomez, O. N. Rosmej, F. Currell, L. Stella, D. Riley, M. Zepf, M. Yeung, C. L. S. Lewis, B. Dromey
arxiv-2409-08689.description: Abstract Ionising radiation interactions in matter can trigger a cascade of processes that underpin long-lived damage in the medium. To date, however, a lack of suitable methodologies has precluded our ability to understand the role that material nanostructure plays in this cascade.

arxiv-2409-10495.title: On the thermodynamic limit of interacting fermions in the continuum
arxiv-2409-10495.creator: Oliver Siebert Department of Mathematics, University of Tübingen Auf der Morgenstelle 10, 72076 Tübingen, Germany
arxiv-2409-10495.description: Abstract We study the dynamics of non-relativistic fermions in ℝ d {\mathbb{R}}^{d} interacting through a pair potential. Employing methods developed by Buchholz in the framework of resolvent algebras, we consider an extension of the CAR algebra where the dynamics acts as a group of ∗ * -automorphisms, which are continuous in time in all sectors for fixed particle numbers.

arxiv-2501-14353.title: Bifurcation of gravity-capillary Stokes waves with constant vorticity
arxiv-2501-14353.creator: T. Barbieri, M. Berti, A. Maspero, M. Mazzucchelli
arxiv-2501-14353.description: Abstract Abstract. We consider the gravity-capillary water waves equations of a 2D fluid with constant vorticity. By employing variational methods we prove the bifurcation of periodic traveling water waves –which are steady in a moving frame– for all the values of gravity, surface tension, constant vorticity, depth and wavelenght, extending previous results valid for restricted values of the parameters.

arxiv-2506-04650.title: Neural Network Reprogrammability: A Unified Theme on Model Reprogramming, Prompt Tuning, and Prompt Instruction
arxiv-2506-04650.creator: Zesheng Ye, Chengyi Cai, Ruijiang Dong, Jianzhong Qi, Lei Feng, Pin-Yu Chen, Feng Liu
arxiv-2506-04650.description: Abstract As large-scale pre-trained foundation models continue to expand in size and capability, efficiently adapting them to specific downstream tasks has become increasingly critical. Despite substantial research progress, existing adaptation approaches have evolved largely in isolation, without a clear understanding of their interrelationships.

arxiv-2508-09839.title: A First Look at Starlink In-Flight Performance: An Intercontinental Empirical Study
arxiv-2508-09839.creator: Muhammad Asad Ullah 1 , Luca Borgianni 2 , Heikki Kokkinen 1 , Antti Anttonen 1 , Stefano Giordano 2
arxiv-2508-09839.description: Abstract Starlink delivers Internet services to users across terrestrial, maritime, and aviation domains. The prior works have studied its performance at fixed sites and in-motion vehicles, while an in-depth analysis of in-flight performance remains absent. With major airlines now offering Starlink Internet onboard, there is a growing need to evaluate and improve its performance for aviation users.

arxiv-2508-10194.title: A multi-wavelength view of the multi-messenger sources NGC 1068 and PKS 1502+106 Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2508-10194.creator: Abhishek Desai, Stefano Marchesi, Justin Vandenbroucke, Indrani Pal, Ke Fang, Dieter Hartmann, Regina Caputo, Marco Ajello, Jessie Thwaites, Kavic R Kumar, Sam Hori
arxiv-2508-10194.description: Abstract Multi-messenger astronomy offers a powerful approach to studying high-energy radiative processes in astrophysical sources. A notable example was seen in 2017, when the IceCube Neutrino Observatory detected a high-energy neutrino event that was found to coincide with a gamma-ray flare from a blazar.

arxiv-2602-21748.title: Formation timescales for stellar bars in diverse galactic discs 2026 Formation timescales for stellar bars in diverse galactic discs – 9
arxiv-2602-21748.creator: Matthew Frosst, Danail Obreschkow, Aaron Ludlow
arxiv-2602-21748.description: Abstract We study the formation of stellar bars using 145 simulations of disc galaxies embedded in live and static dark matter haloes. We use the exponential bar growth timescale, τ bar \tau_{\rm bar} , to quantify how disc structure and kinematics regulate the onset and rate of secular bar formation.

pmc-12534592.creator: Qinghai Zhang, Xiaoliang Xu, Lihua Wu, Jianlin Li, Quan Shi, Delin Tan
pmc-12534592.description: To study the dynamic mechanical response and energy dissipation law of fractured sandstone, an SHPB device combined with a high-speed camera system was used to carry out impact compression tests with seven rock bridge angle specimens. The dynamic strength characteristics of fractured sandstone and the crack initiation stress at the fracture tip was explored.

pmc-12559953.title: Butterflies (Lepidoptera) of the Can Gio Mangrove Biosphere Reserve, Vietnam
pmc-12559953.creator: Hiep Ngoc Dang, Hoan Duc Huynh, Trung Van Phan, Kiet Nguyen The Bui, Thao Thi Thu Luong, Vu Dang Hoang Nguyen
pmc-12559953.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundThe Can Gio Mangrove Biosphere Reserve is a unique transitional ecosystem between land and sea and represents a significant wetland area in southern Vietnam. Despite being recognised as a biodiversity hotspot, its butterfly fauna remains poorly documented.New informationIn this study, the Pollard Walk method was employed across 72 sampling events in 12 fixed transects, presenting the first comprehensive checklist and diversity assessment of butterflies (Lepidoptera, Rhopalocera) from this region.

pmc-12621609.title: A Case of IgG4-Related Disease Presenting with Skin Lesions and Proptosis as Initial Manifestations
pmc-12621609.creator: Shenglan Wang, Meiqiong Liu, Yuanyu Feng, Dongjie Sun, Hui Zhang
pmc-12621609.description: BackgroundIgG4-related disease (IgG4-RD) is a rare chronic fibroinflammatory disorder. Elevated serum IgG4 levels and infiltration of IgG4-positive plasma cells into affected tissues are characteristic of it. It often involves multiple organs. However, initial presentations with cutaneous involvement are relatively rare. To better understand and treat the associated disease, we report this case.

pmc-13327182.title: The uncertain self: Intolerance of uncertainty moderates the association of both positive and disorganized schizotypal traits with self-concept clarity in a non-clinical sample
pmc-13327182.creator: Alexandra Kaszás, Szabolcs Kéri, Dorottya Bencze, Ágnes Szőllősi, Ágota Vass, Mihály Racsmány, Bertalan Polner, Gerard Hutchinson, Gerard Hutchinson, Gerard Hutchinson, Gerard Hutchinson
pmc-13327182.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Our objective was to investigate the relationship between self-concept clarity, intolerance of uncertainty, and schizotypal traits, with a focus on whether intolerance of uncertainty moderates the association between self-concept clarity and positive schizotypy in a non-clinical context. A sample of 315 adults (on average 43 (SD = 12) years, 247 women) completed the Self-Concept Clarity Scale, the Intolerance of Uncertainty scale, and the Schizotypal Personality Questionnaire – Brief Revised.

pmc-13408593.title: Performance evaluation of DF-based cooperative DCSK for next-generation wireless networks
pmc-13408593.creator: Maiss M. Al-Khasawneh, Mamoun F. Al-Mistarihi, Moawiah Alhulayil, Mohammed M. Alammar
pmc-13408593.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Differential chaos shift keying (DCSK) is a non-coherent modulation technique that has attracted attention for communication over fading channels. This paper investigates the performance of a cooperative DCSK system employing decode-and-forward (DF) relaying over Rayleigh and Nakagami-m fading environments. Analytical expressions are developed for outage probability and average-capacity evaluation, while the bit error performance is examined through an analytical treatment supported by Monte Carlo simulation.
